latest.title: Conformal boundary rigidity for simple Finsler metrics
latest.abstract: In this paper we prove that simple Finsler manifolds are conformally stable. Given a simple Finsler manifold and a class of conformal factors, we characterize the singularity of their induced boundary distance functions which allows us to define an appropiate $H^2$ norm. We then obtain a stability estimate with respect to this Sobolev norm and the $L^2$ norm on the class of the conformal factors. To prove the main theorems, we adapt the classical integration by parts technique employed by Mukhometov \cite{Muhometov} to the Finsler setting.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 证明简单 Finsler 流形在共形类中的边界距离稳定性，并处理距离数据的奇性。
latest.breakthrough: 把经典边界刚性稳定估计推广到 Finsler 设定。
latest.limitations: 简单性与指定共形因子类不可省略，未解决一般 Finsler 边界刚性。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.priorityReason: 刚性与逆问题技术相关性高，Sobolev 数据范数处理可复用。
